summary: JOYY Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, reporting its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results via Exhibit 99.1 press release. The report details net revenues of US$590.8 million (up 16.3% year-over-year), operating income of US$13.8 million, Non-GAAP net income of US$63.5 million, and net cash of US$3,059.3 million. Business highlights include growth in Social Entertainment, BIGO Ads, and Shopline segments, with global MAUs reaching 277.1 million. This is a routine earnings announcement, containing no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. The filing is purely informational, reflecting standard quarterly performance disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
